**BQF*** is an intervention code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify preventive conversations and special preventive interventions—including all associated subcodes—specifically in the context of [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. It is part of a standardized data collection framework managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to measure and ensure the quality of diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care for cardiovascular patients [^src1].

In clinical quality reporting, BQF* is utilized alongside other specific procedure codes to track patient education and preventive initiatives. For example, when documenting patient education for atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter, the primary code [[bfkb|BFKB]] is used in conjunction with BQF*, [[bvds|BVDS]], and [[bvdy-star|BVDY*]] [^src1]. This systematic coding enables standardized data collection and cross-regional comparison of preventive care quality across Denmark [^src1].
